statements.statement: School committee voted the bottom line at a 3% increase, matching the town manager's recommendation, to carry to Town Hall.
The initial request was a 5.5% increase before being reduced to 3%.
37 percent of Chapter 70 funds are proposed to be used for the local school budget, up from 33 percent in FY14.
Health insurance line is up due to renewal rate and added enrollment.

warnings.condition: until Title I final numbers are known in July
warnings.prediction: Hiring frozen because Title I funding is expected to fall; layoffs possible if teachers were hired and funds lost.
